policy: Use 2026 metric tables as primary; pressure-specific performance overrides nominal marketing ranges.
Resolve numerical errors only when an official metric value is corroborated by the current US row; preserve the original conflict in this audit.
Independent output rounding does not imply a conflict: rounded GPM or whole-foot radii need not convert exactly into independently rounded metric outputs.
Treat special-pattern metric pressures 1.5/2.0 bar as explicitly published metric design points; preserve US-unit convention discrepancy as a note, never silently convert or extrapolate.
Disputed precipitation can be null without invalidating sound pressure/radius/flow.
Never remove conflicting pressure/radius/flow rows and interpolate across the gap; keep affected model hydraulically unresolved.
Unknown quantitative radius-flow laws and exact high-low curve remain unknown.
